cohort: Pregnant women hospitalized for delivery care at Hospital San Bartolome in Lima, Peru.
finding: The majority of pregnant women with COVID-19 were asymptomatic, with low rates of complications and cesarean sections, although a small number of neonates tested positive for COVID-19, and there was an increase in fetal deaths observed.
mod_finding: The study found a low rate of cesarean sections compared to other publications, with all cesareans performed for obstetric indications.
birth_weight: 61% of newborns weighed between 2,500 and 3,500 g
